title: The Seattle Storm played a good first half but fell flat in the 2nd, lost 88-68 to the Minnesota Lynx. Natisha Hiedeman and Jade Melbourne led the Storm with 14 pts each. Natasha Howard and rookie Olivia Miles impressed for Minnesota. #WNBA
